findings.description: In the async retry_any.__ror__, the flatten check tests isinstance(other, retry_all) instead of retry_any, so a left-hand retry_all is merged into the retry_any.
findings.rationale: Trigger: an async retry_all as the left operand of |, e.g. all_cond | any_cond, which dispatches to any_cond.__ror__(all_cond). The check passes, so the result is retry_any(*all_cond.retries, *any_cond.retries), i.e. any(a, b, c) instead of any(all(a, b), c). Impact: the retry predicate silently changes meaning and retries under conditions it should not, or fails to retry when it should.
